macro.reasoning: Temperature shows a clear downward trend from ~29.7°C in late September to ~26.7°C by early November, with a recent acceleration in cooling (last 10 days average -0.2°C/day). High humidity (84-88%) and persistent heavy precipitation (10-23mm) in the last week indicate a stable cool, wet regime typical of seasonal transition. The trend projects continued cooling at ~0.2°C/day over the 7-day horizon, reaching the mid-25s°C.
